continuity_constraints.rule: Every dialogue cut shows the participant who is speaking in that span.
Camera switches stay on one side of the dialogue axis; no axis cross without a wide re-establishing cut.
Speech audio is continuous across camera switches; no word is clipped at a cut point.

cut_ranges.reason: Open on the calibration exchange; establish both speakers before tightening.
Keep the complete question-and-answer beat that follows the opening.
Held-out repeat of the opening tasking on footage the tuning loop never saw.
Held-out repeat of the exchange tasking on footage the tuning loop never saw.

expected_source_moments.description: Opening of the calibration podcast exchange; both speakers establish the topic.
Follow-up question and full answer on the calibration source.
Opening of the held-out podcast exchange; tuning never saw this footage.
Follow-up question and full answer on the held-out source.

brief.intent: Cut a tight two-speaker podcast exchange from the multicam originals: open on the topic, keep one complete question-and-answer beat, and show the speaking participant at every cut.

preference_rubric.description: Every line is intelligible; no clipped words at cuts.
The visible camera always matches the speaker; axis is preserved.
The exchange breathes but never drags; no dead air survives.
